interaction.prompt: Your centre wins the defensive-zone draw clean back to you. Tap your first read.

feedback.right: The forecheck collapsed hard on your strong side the instant the puck landed. Your weak-side D is the safety valve — an easy D-to-D pass moves it to space with no pressure and starts the breakout clean.
feedback.wrong: Both the centre and your strong-side wing already have a forechecker on top of them from the win — that pass is contested before it gets there. Your weak-side D is standing in space with nobody near. That's the safe first move.

tip: A clean faceoff win doesn't mean a clean lane. Check where the pressure landed before you decide where the puck goes.
why: The forecheck's structure is built to jump the strong side the instant a draw is won there. Reading that pressure and finding the weak-side D keeps the breakout simple and possession safe, instead of forcing a pass into numbers.
